added_lines: notices mass intentions st. vincent de paul collection the monthly collection for our svp conference will take place this weekend. candlelit liturgy of remembrance on wednesday november 4th at 7 pm we will remember and pray for all those whose funerals have taken place here in st. patrick’s over the last year in a special candlelit liturgy of remembrance. this special candlelit liturgy is also open to all parishioners who would like to attend, and light a special votive candle in memory of their loved ones. altar list for the dead if you wish to have the names of your loved ones prayed for during november and on the first friday of each month throughout the year, please write their names on the sheet provided on the table at the back of the church, and put in the envelope provided. you may wish to include a voluntary offering. these can be placed in the metal collection boxes or returned to the parish office. archdiocese of dublin employment opportunities the archdiocese of dublin is currently recruiting for three key roles. a twin pillar strategy & mission lead will provide strategic leadership for a major renewal initiative centred on st mary’s cathedral and st andrew’s, westland row, helping to foster outreach, welcome and engagement in the heart of the city. a faith development co- ordinator for youth and young adult ministries (northside) will support the growth of youth ministry, develop leadership programmes, and recruit and mentor new youth leaders. the role of post primary diocesan advisor involves supporting religious education in secondary schools and working closely with principals, teachers, chaplains and diocesan agencies. further details are available on the diocesan website. monkstown
